title: Weary Face Emoji 😩 Meaning: From Exhausted to Thirsty
description: The 😩 weary face emoji means fed up, exhausted or dramatically overwhelmed, and online it also signals craving or desire. See what it means in your texts.
summary: The 😩 weary face tilts its eyebrows up, shuts its eyes and opens its mouth in a groan. It means the sender is worn out or fed up, usually with comic exaggeration. Online it has a second life expressing intense craving, from wanting pizza to finding someone extremely attractive.
meaning: The basic message is a long, drawn-out “ughhh.” 😩 is what people send when the alarm goes off on Monday, when the group project partner disappears, or when the line has not moved in twenty minutes. The tiredness is real but performed; the emoji turns a complaint into a small piece of theater that friends are meant to enjoy.

Over the past decade it picked up a suggestive side. The open mouth and scrunched eyes can be read as a moan, and people began using 😩 under photos of attractive celebrities and partners to mean “this is too much for me.” Combined with 💦 or 🍆 it becomes explicitly sexual. Sent alone under a selfie, it is thirst expressed as mock suffering.

The same “I can't take it” logic covers non-sexual cravings and delight. Food that looks incredible, a song that hits hard, a pair of shoes out of budget: “I need it 😩.” It also expresses being overwhelmed by cuteness or laughter, though 😭 is more common for both. Because of the suggestive association, many people avoid it in family and work chats and choose 😫 for plain exhaustion.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: Among friends it is a standard complaint emoji: “I have to be up at five 😩.” Nobody expects a solution. It also expresses longing, as in “I miss summer 😩” or “that pasta 😩.” The suggestive sense appears mainly between partners or in reaction to someone's looks.

contexts.label: On TikTok and Instagram
contexts.body: Under thirst traps and celebrity photos, 😩 means the commenter finds the person painfully attractive. Under food or fashion videos it means they want what they see. In humor it is used for exaggerated exasperation, often with all caps, and in memes mocking overly dramatic reactions.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: A 😩 in reply to your photo is a strong compliment with a flirtatious edge. “Stop being so cute 😩” is affection framed as complaint. If it follows a message about their day, though, they are only tired, so do not read attraction into every instance.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: It is risky. Some colleagues will see harmless fatigue and others will know the sexual connotation, and you cannot tell which in advance. For workload complaints in professional channels, 😫 or 😮‍💨 carry the same tiredness without the baggage. Save 😩 for people who know you.

examples.text: Eight more hours of this shift 😩
examples.meaning: Dramatically fed up with a long workday.
Craving food so much it almost hurts.
Flirtatious: overwhelmed by how attractive someone is.

examples.text: I just got comfortable and the doorbell rang 😩
examples.meaning: Comic exasperation at a small annoyance.
Overcome by how good a piece of music is.
Longing for someone, stated with dramatic emphasis.

combos.meaning: Sexual desire; an explicit way of saying someone is very attractive.
Something is so good the sender is overcome, common for food and music.
Maximum complaint or maximum craving, depending on the topic.
Perfection; a meme-style chef's kiss of approval.

confusedWith.difference: 😫 has tightly scrunched eyes and a squarer open mouth, and reads as straightforward exhaustion or frustration. 😩 has raised brows and a rounder mouth, and it carries the suggestive, craving meanings that 😫 mostly lacks.
😭 streams tears and covers laughter, sadness and affection. 😩 has no tears; it groans, and is tied more closely to being fed up or wanting something badly.
🤤 shows desire directly, with drool, and is mostly about food or attraction. 😩 expresses the same wanting as a kind of agony, which makes it more dramatic and broader in use.

avoid: Avoid it in work and family chats where the sexual connotation could be misread.
Do not leave it under a stranger's photo unless you intend it as a come-on.
It is too theatrical for real burnout or distress; plain words will be taken more seriously.
design: A yellow face with closed eyes, eyebrows slanting upward in the middle and an open, downturned mouth, as if groaning. Designs are similar across vendors, with differences in how wide the mouth opens and whether teeth are shown. It has been in Unicode since 2010 and has a cat counterpart, the weary cat 🙀.

faqs.a: It can. Many people use it to express strong attraction or arousal, especially with 💦 or under photos of someone they find attractive. It also has innocent uses for tiredness and frustration, so the context decides.

faqs.q: What does 😩 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: If he sends it about your photo or something you said, he likely finds you very attractive or is flirting. If it is about work, school or traffic, he is simply tired or annoyed.

faqs.q: What does 😩 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: Usually exaggerated frustration, exhaustion or longing: she is fed up, wants something badly, or misses someone. Directed at a person's looks, it is a flirtatious compliment.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😩 and 😫?
faqs.a: Both show fatigue and people often swap them. 😫 is the cleaner choice for being tired or frustrated. 😩 is more dramatic and is the one associated with craving and thirst.
Not necessarily. It shows a suffering face, but the suffering is frequently a joke about loving something too much. “This cake 😩” is high praise.
